places.name: Trakai Island Castle (on Lake Galvė)
places.ai_summary: A stunning medieval castle on an island in Lake Galvė, offering rich history and picturesque views.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available upon request.

places.place_tip: Take a boat ride around the castle for unique views.

places.name: Trakai History Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum in Trakai showcasing the region's history, culture, and artifacts, located within the Island Castle.

opening_hours.notes: Check for temporary exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Explore the museum's collection of medieval artifacts.

places.name: Uzutrakis Manor & Park
places.ai_summary: A beautiful manor house with a park, offering a glimpse into the aristocratic life of the past.
places.cost: Free entry to the park; manor tours have a fee

opening_hours.notes: Check manor tour availability in advance.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the beautiful park and lake views.

places.name: Trakai Wooden Houses Street Walk
places.ai_summary: A charming street in Trakai featuring traditional wooden houses, reflecting the unique architecture of the region.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot.

places.place_tip: Take photos of the unique wooden architecture.
places.address: Trakai Wooden Houses Street, Trakai, Lithuania

places.name: Kenesa Karaite Temple
places.ai_summary: A unique religious building in Trakai, representing the Karaite community's heritage and architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Respect the religious practices when visiting.

places.place_tip: Learn about the unique Karaite culture and religion.

places.name: Trakai Peninsula Castle Ruins
places.ai_summary: The ruins of a castle on the peninsula, offering a glimpse into the medieval history of Trakai.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the ruins and enjoy the surrounding nature.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the Trakai Island Castle.
places.address: Trakai Peninsula Castle Ruins, Trakai, Lithuania

places.name: Kibinai Traditional Pastry Shops
places.ai_summary: Shops in Trakai offering Kibinai, a traditional Karaite pastry, known for its delicious filling and unique dough.

opening_hours.notes: Try the various fillings: meat, mushrooms, cabbage, and more.

places.place_tip: Visit multiple shops to taste different Kibinai varieties.

places.name: Galvė Lake Boat Tours
places.ai_summary: Boat tours on Lake Galvė, offering a unique perspective of Trakai's castles and natural beauty.

opening_hours.notes: Book tours in advance, especially during peak season.

places.best_time_to_visit: Sunrise or sunset for the best views
places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the stunning scenery.
places.address: Galvė Lake Boat Tours, Trakai, Lithuania

places.name: Trakai Hill of Angels
places.ai_summary: A hill in Trakai offering panoramic views of the town, lakes, and castles, especially beautiful at sunset.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for sunset views.

places.place_tip: Bring a blanket and enjoy a picnic with a view.
places.address: Trakai Hill of Angels, Trakai, Lithuania

places.name: Old Town Bridge & Photo Spot
places.ai_summary: A picturesque bridge in Trakai's Old Town, popular for photos, especially with the castle in the background.

opening_hours.notes: Best lighting for photos is early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby cafes after taking photos.

places.name: Varnikai Nature Trail
places.ai_summary: A scenic nature trail in Trakai, perfect for hiking and enjoying the local flora and fauna.

opening_hours.notes: Wear comfortable shoes and bring water.

places.place_tip: Look out for the diverse bird species in the area.

places.name: Trakai Orthodox Church
places.ai_summary: An Orthodox church in Trakai, known for its beautiful architecture and peaceful surroundings.

opening_hours.notes: Respect the religious practices when visiting.

places.place_tip: Enjoy the tranquility and take in the architectural details.

places.name: Historic Karaim Ethnic Quarter
places.ai_summary: A historic area in Trakai, showcasing the unique culture and heritage of the Karaim people.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the area and visit the Kenesa.

places.place_tip: Try to visit the Kenesa Karaite Temple during your walk.
places.address: Historic Karaim Ethnic Quarter, Trakai, Lithuania

places.ai_summary: The visitor center for Trakai Regional Park, providing information and exhibits about the park's nature and history.

opening_hours.notes: Check for guided tour availability.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the nearby nature trails.
places.address: Trakai Regional Park Visitor Centre, Trakai, Lithuania

places.name: Rowboat & Kayak Rentals
places.ai_summary: Rentals for rowboats and kayaks on Lake Galvė, offering a fun and active way to explore the lake.

opening_hours.notes: Book in advance during peak season.

places.place_tip: Explore the small islands on Lake Galvė.

places.name: Trakai Observation Point
places.ai_summary: An observation point in Trakai offering stunning views of the Trakai Island Castle and the surrounding lakes.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise or sunset.

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for better views.

places.ai_summary: A scenic spot in Trakai to view the reflections of the castles on the water at sunset.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed from the lakeshore.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera and a tripod for long exposure shots.

places.name: Winter Ice Walks on Lake Galvė
places.ai_summary: Experience walking on the frozen Lake Galvė in winter, a unique and magical experience.
places.name_english: Winter Ice Walks on Lake Galvė

opening_hours.notes: Check ice conditions and safety guidelines.

places.place_tip: Dress warmly and wear suitable footwear.
